verdict.rationale: Gladia is API-first. Its docs describe a single API for asynchronous and real-time transcription, with documented request parameters (`model`, `custom_vocabulary_config`) and pre-recorded quickstarts. The live init call returns a session id and connectable URL. Probes confirm the docs are publicly reachable, including llms.txt and markdown versions. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec at the probed paths, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in use.
